args: ROOT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; [ -z "$ROOT" ] && ROOT=$(cat ~/.claude/channels/rx-claude-matrix-bridge/plugin-root 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$ROOT" ] && ROOT="$PWD"; if [ -f "$ROOT/dist/server.js" ]; then exec node "$ROOT/dist/server.js"; elif [ -f "$ROOT/server.ts" ]; then cd "$ROOT" && exec npx --yes tsx server.ts; else echo "matrix-bridge: cannot locate server (ROOT=$ROOT). Check plugin install or run npm run build in the repo." >&2; exit 1; fi
